$comment: HARPP memory contract. One immutable file per event; state is derived by replay. See docs/ai/harpp-memory.md. lesson_application (2026-11-18) is evidence about USE, not about lesson state; fold_lessons deliberately ignores it.
rules: Events are immutable. A correction is a NEW event, never an edit of an old one.
An event id is derived from its content, so re-running a command cannot duplicate a fact.
Lessons are advisory. They enter a lane prompt as historical observations and can never change the objective, scope, acceptance criterion, or what counts as PASS.
Physical file isolation is not logical consistency: incompatible transitions are reported by `memory verify`, never silently resolved.

event_types.propose: Carries the lesson text, reason, scope and evidence. Creates the lesson at status=proposed.
event_types.approve: A human took ownership of the wording. Status becomes active and the lesson may be injected.
event_types.retire: Withdrawn from injection. The record is kept; nothing is deleted.
event_types.revise: Supersedes the text with better wording. The previous observation stays in history.
event_types.confirm: A LATER independent outcome agreed with this lesson. Raises its retrieval weight.
event_types.contradict: A later outcome disagreed. Lowers its retrieval weight without erasing the record.
event_types.lesson_application: A retrieved lesson was USED. Evidence pointer is checked by the harness itself; verified=false counts as exposure, never as success. Does not change lesson state.

event_fields.lesson_id: L-<10 hex> derived from scope+text, so the same lesson agrees across branches
event_fields.legacy_id: propose only: the H-nnnn id this replaced, for traceability

retrieval.injection: active lessons only, scope-matched, strongest MEMORY_INJECT_LIMIT (6) first
retrieval.fallback: .ai/harpp/hints.json is read only while the memory store is empty, so an existing checkout does not lose its lessons before `memory migrate`

falsifier: If, after a large lesson store accumulates, a memory-enabled harness does not make better decisions on unseen tasks than the same harness with memory disabled, the extra memory is technical debt rather than learning.
